title: The Bhagavad-Gita: Krishna's Counsel in Time of War

publication.edition: English translation with introduction and afterword

verification.verification_notes: Confirmed the Gita is a Sanskrit philosophical dialogue in verse between Krishna and Arjuna, set on a battlefield, in which instruction steadily generalises from the immediate crisis to principle (action, duty, self).

limitations: Claims concern the structure of instruction and address, not Sanskrit prosody.

copyright.notes: Original public domain; Miller translation copyrighted; no passages reproduced.
